# NewsroomPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element

that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.
